_note: Pack trees (#287): detailed trees of the private nature pack (assets-private/synty/glb/nature) within near_m of the player in place of the baked box/pyramid trees. Without the pack, with DRYCASTLE_PACK_TREES=0, or on a map whose trees.json lacks model.base_uv2, nothing changes. A tree's base point inside near_m is a pack tree and outside it a baked one (cut in the shaders, global parameter tree_cut); over the last fade_m inside near_m both are drawn, dithered against each other. tile_m: the pack trees are merged into one mesh per tile and material (a tile costs one draw per material; smaller tiles cull better, bigger ones draw less and take longer to build). ahead_m: tiles are built this far past near_m, and freed 2 * ahead_m past it. max_in_flight: tiles being built on worker threads at once. budget_ms: what handing finished tiles to the renderer may take per frame (one surface at least). scale_min / scale_max: a tree is scaled to the height of the code-built tree; a model is chosen among those whose scale lies within this span (the nearest one when none does). bulk_share: the share of trees that take a bulk model (single material, the shared atlas: they merge into one draw per tile); the others take an occasional model (own leaf textures, more draws). shadows: whether pack trees cast shadows themselves; off, the baked tree in the same place casts the sun shadow for them (on roughly doubled the draw calls of a view). shapes: the models that stand in for the tree shapes of trees.json (cone, box), by name in nature/manifest.json, chosen by a hash of the tree's position in proportion to weight; bulk marks a bulk model; a name the pack does not have is skipped.
